items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was there when Senior was there, but then he didn’t stay there that long. He retired.

ctx.x: Tell us about Abyssinian Baptist Church and what you recollect of – now that was Adam Clayton Powell, Sr.

I was there when Senior was there, but then he didn’t stay there that long. He retired. Then Adam, Jr., came in. I mostly remember Adam, Jr., for the years I went there. It was every Sunday. We never missed a Sunday. I had to go first to the Mt. Olive Baptist Church for a Sunday school, where my godfather taught Sunday school. That was right there.
